_about: SYNTHETIC answers, written by the authoring session for an invented case: a loan book for shared tools at a community workshop. No real person or organisation is described.

job-one-line.v: Let whoever is on the desk see which tools are out, who has them and when they are due back, without leafing through the paper book.

current-method.v: By hand, on paper or from memory
current-method.note: A bound book at the desk. Entries get skipped when it is busy.

v: The information ends up in several places
It cannot be done away from a desk
pain.note: Late returns are chased from memory. Two volunteers keep their own lists.

time-per-run.note: Timed three loans last Saturday: 2 to 4 minutes each, mostly finding the right page.

success-test.v:
A member asks where the long clamps are. The desk volunteer looks at a phone and says: out since Tuesday, due back tomorrow, and here is who has them.

Today that takes a walk to the rack and ten minutes with the book.

user-count.note: About a dozen desk volunteers on a roster. Members do not log in.

phone-conditions.note: Often holding the tool being returned in the other hand.

comfort.note: Several volunteers avoid anything with a login. Two are very capable.

offline.note: The wi-fi drops out at the back of the building.

records.v:
Tools (name, tag number, where it lives)
Members (name, member number)
Loans (tool, member, date out, date due, date back)
Faults reported on return

existing-data.v: Yes, in a spreadsheet or CSV file
existing-data.note: The tool list is in a spreadsheet, about 340 rows. Loans are only in the book.

v: Names or contact details of people

loss-cost.note: A lost day means not knowing who has what. It can be rebuilt by asking around, but that is a bad look.

must-have.v:
Sign a tool out to a member in under 30 seconds
Sign it back in, with a note if it is damaged
Show everything that is out, oldest first
Show overdue loans

not-doing.v:
No payments or fines
No booking ahead
No member self-service in the first version

deadline.v: Sooner is better, with no fixed date

certainty.note: Sure about loans. Less sure whether fault reports belong in the same tool.

anything-else.v: The desk phone is old and its screen is cracked, so big buttons matter more than looks.
